{{recipesummary|category=Tuna recipes|servings=6|time=45 minutes|difficulty=1}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==

*3 cans of [[Cookbook:Tuna|tuna]] in water
*1 can each of cream of celery soup, cream of chicken soup, and cream of mushroom soup (substitute cream of potato if you don't like mushrooms)
*1 bag of frozen vegetables ([[Cookbook:Pea|peas]], [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], and [[Cookbook:Corn|corn]])
*1 large bag of egg [[Cookbook:Noodle|noodles]]
*1 can of fried onion rings, 1 packet potato chips, or 1 small packet [[Cookbook:Corn flakes|corn flakes]]

==Procedure==
# Cook egg noodles as directed on package. While boiling water, preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 400°F.
# Drain egg noodles. Mix together all ingredients except fried onion rings. Put in a [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|casserole dish]] or a 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan. [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 20 minutes.
# Sprinkle fried onion topping on top of baked casserole. Bake for an additional 3 minutes, or until fried onion is slightly brown.
# Let cool for 5 minutes and serve.

==Notes, tips, and variations==

* You can substitute any of the cream soups with the flavor of your choice.
* You can sprinkle with Old Bay or any other seafood seasoning for added taste.
